# Aditya Karnam

> Aditya Karnam is an AI research engineer working across the AI stack: hardware and inference performance, model training and distillation, agent systems, retrieval and memory, evals and software factories. This site holds his research, experiment write-ups and open-source systems. Results are measured on small models and fixed budgets, with the harnesses published.

## Research
- [Research index](https://adityakarnam.com/ai-research/): papers, experiments and software with findings
- [BudgetBench (arXiv:2609.13149)](https://adityakarnam.com/budgetbench-explained): memory strategy evaluation under a fixed token budget
- [Distilling Ornith-1.5-9B on MLX](https://adityakarnam.com/distilling-ornith-9b-two-teacher-mlx/): a 4.9 GB build that beats the 8.9 GB release it replaces
- [MLX non-determinism on Apple Silicon](https://adityakarnam.com/mlx-non-determinism-apple-silicon)
- [GEMV vs GEMM roofline on Apple Silicon](https://adityakarnam.com/mlx-gemv-gemm-roofline-apple-silicon/)
- [Speculative decoding with Qwen3 on Apple Silicon](https://adityakarnam.com/mlx-speculative-decoding-qwen3-8-apple-silicon/)
- [Tokens per paper: DocLang vs Docling vs raw PDF](https://adityakarnam.com/tokens-per-paper-doclang-docling-pdf/)

## Systems and open source
- [Live](https://adityakarnam.com/live/): running software, an in-browser paper search (OpenAlex), docs for subagent-fleet and embenx, and mcp-scholarly (185 GitHub stars)
- [Systems](https://adityakarnam.com/systems/): subagent-fleet, embenx, Quecto and agent memory tooling
- [Quecto](https://adityakarnam.com/quecto/): a small Rust coding-agent harness
- [embenx](https://adityakarnam.com/embenx-python-embedding-toolkit/): retrieval library for agent memory
- [subagent-fleet](https://adityakarnam.com/subagent-fleet-local-ai-compute-control-plane): local compute control plane for coding-agent subagents
- [Agent memory frameworks compared](https://adityakarnam.com/awesome-agentic-memory/)
- [mlx-lm PR #1795](https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-lm/pull/1795): fix for LoRA training on MoE models
